name: Dr. Geetika Kilra
about: Dr. Geetika Kilra is a dedicated General Medicine specialist providing comprehensive adult healthcare, diagnosis, and management of a wide spectrum of medical conditions.

name: Dr. Mohit Bharadwaj
about: Dr. Mohit Bharadwaj specializes in pulmonology, treating respiratory conditions including asthma, COPD, sleep disorders, and critical respiratory illnesses with evidence-based protocols.

name: Dr. Mayank Pratap Singh
about: Dr. Mayank Pratap Singh is a highly experienced orthopedic surgeon specializing in joint replacement surgeries including total knee and hip replacement with precision techniques.

name: Dr. Rakesh
about: Dr. Rakesh is an orthopedic specialist focused on joint replacement and trauma management, delivering excellent surgical outcomes with minimally invasive approaches.

name: Dr. Jhajharia Rajveer Singh
about: Dr. Jhajharia Rajveer Singh is an expert radiologist with deep expertise in advanced imaging including MRI, CT, ultrasound, digital X-ray, mammography, and interventional radiology.

name: Dr. Mukesh Nandal
about: Dr. Mukesh Nandal is a senior gastroenterologist specializing in digestive disorders, liver disease, endoscopy, and advanced therapeutic GI procedures.

name: Dr. Chandrakanta Arya
about: Dr. Chandrakanta Arya is a renowned obstetrician and gynecologist with expertise in high-risk pregnancy management, laparoscopic gynecology, and maternal-fetal care.

name: Dr. Ashwani Yadav
about: Dr. Ashwani Yadav is a critical care intensivist managing complex ICU cases with 24/7 availability, specializing in multi-organ failure, ventilator management, and sepsis protocols.

name: Dr. Ashwani Yadav
about: Dr. Ashwani Yadav brings extensive expertise in anesthesiology, providing safe perioperative care across all surgical specialties including cardiac, neuro, and orthopedic surgeries.

name: Dr. Yogeshman Anand
about: Dr. Yogeshman Anand is a nephrologist specializing in kidney disease management, dialysis, and renal transplant care with a patient-centric approach.

name: Dr. Aanil
about: Dr. Aanil specializes in plastic and reconstructive surgery, offering procedures for post-trauma reconstruction, wound management, and aesthetic corrections.

name: Dr. Jagtap Rukmaji Prakash
about: Dr. Jagtap Rukmaji Prakash is a distinguished neurosurgeon with 20+ years of expertise in brain and spine surgeries, stroke care, and complex neurosurgical interventions.

name: Dr. Hemant
about: Dr. Hemant is an experienced general and laparoscopic surgeon specializing in minimally invasive procedures, hernia repair, appendectomy, and cholecystectomy.

name: Dr. Praveen Kumar Yadav
about: Dr. Praveen Kumar Yadav is a senior urologist with expertise in urological cancers, kidney stones, prostate disorders, and minimally invasive urological surgeries.

name: Dr. Dixit Garg
about: Dr. Dixit Garg is a senior interventional cardiologist specializing in angioplasty, pacemaker implantation, echocardiography, and comprehensive cardiac care.

name: Dr. Sahil
about: Dr. Sahil is an ENT specialist with expertise in ear, nose, and throat disorders including sinusitis, hearing loss, vertigo, tonsillectomy, and endoscopic sinus surgery.

name: Dr. Mayank Pratap Singh
about: Dr. Mayank Pratap Singh provides comprehensive orthopedic care including fracture management, sports injuries, spine disorders, and musculoskeletal conditions.

name: Dr. Ankit
about: Dr. Ankit is a urologist specializing in endourology, laser treatment of kidney stones, TURP, and advanced urological interventions with excellent patient outcomes.
